children: FiEE's revenue rose 35.1% year over year, while earnings attributable to common stockholders turned positive from a loss. Revenue growth reflected the expansion of SaaS, software, phygital art advisory and other services; lower general and administrative expenses and an income tax benefit also supported quarterly results.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings (loss) per common share”.
: SaaS-MCN digital services revenue fell 40.3%, while software services revenue rose 224.2%; phygital art advisory services contributed $934,212.
: Margin declined to 73.6% from 85.0%, primarily reflecting higher amortization costs in cost of revenues.
: The company had onboarded 939 SaaS-MCN customers, representing $9.2 million in total service fees, as of September 30, 2026.
: FiEE expects art curation, auction and MCN brokerage services to generate revenue in Q4 2026, though contributions may be limited.
